# corpus: a kind: Secret TEMPLATE (every value a placeholder) inside a fenced block
# expect: clean
# refs:   measured false-positive class (a documented kind: Secret example refused)
# shape:  a kind: Secret manifest whose every data/stringData value is a placeholder token
# why:    a template carries no decrypted material; a placeholder is not a leaked value, and a fence is where a manifest gets documented
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: app-credentials
type: Opaque
stringData:
  username: <REDACTED>
  password: ${DB_PASSWORD}
  api-token: {{ vault.token }}
  fallback: PLACEHOLDER
```
